Trail of Bits is a cybersecurity research and consulting firm based in Brooklyn, NY. We work with companies like Epic Games, Google, Microsoft, and Zoom on their hardest security problems: smart contract audits, application security, vulnerability research, and more.

We're hiring 10-12 summer interns (June-August) to work on real client projects and research alongside our security engineers in NYC. You'll contribute to software security assessments, tool development, and research that gets published. What we're looking for:

Strong technical skills: C/C++, Rust, Go, Python, Solidity, etc. Experience in reverse engineering, appsec, program analysis, smart contracts, or cryptography

NYC interns get the full experience: Summercon, team events, Broadway shows, and more.

Remote available for strong candidates.

Actively reviewing applications and interviewing now.

Apply: https://apply.workable.com/trailofbits/j/0C784B6D41/
